name: ge2-caravan
description: GE2 Caravan — dev tooling only (build + Playwright checks). The platform itself is static pages + Supabase/Cloudflare/n8n; this file adds no runtime dependency.

scripts.build: npm run build:studio && npm run build:quests
scripts.test:all: npm run test:syntax && node tests/run.js all
scripts.test:rally: node --test tests/rally/adapter.test.js tests/rally/content.test.js && node caravan/rally/build_page.js --check && node tests/rally/acceptance.js && node tests/rally/mobile.js && node tests/rally/gfx.js
